_purpose: Single source of truth for every event the property sends (Finding 9 fix). scripts/generate-blueprint.mjs emits one payload data element per entry from ONE template, plus the rule that sends it. Adding a tracked interaction = adding an entry here and re-running the generator; hand-editing generated payloads is prohibited.
_analyticsTransport: Per the audit's Fix 1/2 guidance (deck slide 28), payloads use the Web SDK `data.__adobe.analytics` object (the documented AppMeasurement-migration path) — no XDM schema required while Amazon News has no AEP subscription. eVar/prop/event numbers are byte-for-byte the source property's mappings.

_acdlEventSentinel.meaning: The source workbook (Launch Inspector) does not export WHICH adobeDataLayer event name each Datalayer Push Listener listens for. Run scripts/export-current.mjs against the existing AboutAmazon-US property to produce catalog/acdl-events.overrides.json with the real names; generate-blueprint.mjs refuses to emit a publishable blueprint while any acdlEvent is unresolved.

deviationsFromPilot: The scope rides the consolidated page view's SINGLE edge request (decisionScopes on the Global Page Load Rule's Send event) - the pilot's separate per-page sendEvent is eliminated.
The Target answer is consumed via the Web SDK 'Send event complete' rule event instead of a .then() in custom code - same handling, UI-visible rule.
'Include rendered propositions' is OFF on the display notification (was checked in the pilot, where it was a no-op; here renderDecisions:true would make it over-report).
The old 'Newsletter Proposition Data Element' is re-specced from Adobe's documented display-notification payload (id/scope/scopeDetails + propositionEventType.display) rather than copied.

dataElement.name: Target: Newsletter Proposition Data Element
codeLines: // XDM payload for the 'design was shown' notification (Decisioning Proposition
// Display). Supplies the newsletter proposition EXPLICITLY because the site -
// not the SDK - renders this design; 'include rendered propositions' stays OFF
// so unrelated auto-rendered (VEC) propositions never pollute the test's
// display counts (deliberate deviation from the pilot, where renderDecisions
// was never true and the checkbox was a no-op).
propositions: [{ id: p.id, scope: p.scope, scopeDetails: p.scopeDetails }],

rules.name: Newsletter Test: Resolve Experience
codeLines: // Newsletter sign-up test - CONTINUED from the pilot built in the old property.
// The page-view request already asked Target for the newsletter scope on the ONE
// edge call this property makes per page; this rule runs when that call completes
// and hands Target's answer to the site. Site contract UNCHANGED from the pilot:
if (!match) return; // visitor not in the test, or a send that didn't carry the scope
window.__newsletterProposition = match; // report-back handle (display + sign-up credit)
name: 'newsletter:design', // which feature this message is about
value: content.variant     // which version to show ('contextual' | 'generic' | 'interstitial')

rules.name: Newsletter Test: Form Success
codeLines: // The message we get when someone actually signs up. It contains:
// NOTE (Known Gap, carried from the pilot): location only ever has these two
// values today - contextual / generic / interstitial are NOT distinguished yet.
var placement = detail.location || 'unknown'; // which part of the page they signed up from
// Combined event: tells Target AND Analytics a real sign-up happened, AND
// credits the specific design that produced it - both signals on the one
console.log('[Newsletter Test] Sending combined confirmation event:', xdmPayload);
// Fallback: proposition unavailable - still record the confirmation so
// Analytics has the signal, even though Target attribution is lost.
console.warn('[Newsletter Test] No proposition on window.__newsletterProposition - falling back to plain pageview (Target attribution lost for this signup).');
